description:
🍓 Whole Mixed Berries (Strawberry, Blueberry & Raspberry) , 0% Added Sugar – : Enjoy the taste of juicy berries without any refined sugar.

✅ Sweetened with FOS & Honey:Made delicious with no artificial sweeteners

❌ No Preservatives, No Artificial Flavors – Just whole juicy berries, bursting with flavor and nutrition.

Our Mixed Berry jam is incredibly versatile! Try it with toast, swirl it into oats or smoothies, and enjoy it with pancakes, rotis, or crackers.

For 2–3 year olds, please check with your nutritionist before serving.
